text: おおむかし　うみに　すんでいた　こだい　ポケモンの　カセキ。

structure.jp: おおむかし　うみに　すんでいた
structure.en: that lived in the sea long, long ago

structure.jp: こだい　ポケモンの　カセキ。
structure.en: a fossil of an ancient Pokémon

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おおむかし　うみに　すんでいた　こだい　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in an action word placed right before a thing describes that thing. うみに　すんでいた　こだい　ポケモン = 'an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた is the past of ている and shows a state that went on for a while back then. すんでいた = 'was living, used to live'.
